cases.title: Elapsed Time Components
cases.student_body:
I need to write elapsed_parts(total_seconds), which takes a nonnegative integer and returns a tuple (hours, minutes, seconds). Hours can be any nonnegative integer; minutes and seconds must each be between 0 and 59.

Here is my code:
```python
def elapsed_parts(total_seconds):
    hours = total_seconds // 3600
    minutes = total_seconds // 60
    seconds = total_seconds % 60
    return hours, minutes, seconds
```

For elapsed_parts(3661), I get (1, 61, 1), but the task expects (1, 1, 1). For elapsed_parts(59), I get the expected (0, 0, 59). I know integer division and remainder, but I am confused about why the minutes do not reset after an hour.
